rules.content:

rules.content:
title: Residential Proxy Login Attempt
status: experimental
description: Detects login attempts originating from known residential proxy networks. Credential stuffing actors increasingly route attacks through residential proxies (Luminati/Bright Data, Oxylabs, SmartProxy) 
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: auth_logs
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "login_attempt"
            - "login_success"
    selection_proxy:
        source_ip_threat_intel|contains:
            - "residential_proxy"
            - "proxy_network"
        source_ip_category: "residential"
        source_asn_type: "isp"
    selection_additional:
        auth_result: "success"
    condition: selection and selection_proxy and selection_additional
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0017: Residential Proxy Login Attempt (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Credential Spray Single Password")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count(distinct username) by password_hash > 20 and count(distinct password_hash) by source_ip < 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auth_logs event_type="login_attempt" auth_result="failure"
| stats dc(username) as unique_username by password_hash
| where unique_username > 20
| stats dc(password_hash) as unique_password_hash by source_ip
| where unique_password_hash < 3
rules.title: DL-0018: Credential Spray Single Password (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Fake Tracking ID (FTID) Refund Fraud Indicators
status: experimental
description: Detects indicators of fake tracking ID (FTID) refund fraud, where a customer claims a package was not received or returned by providing a manipulated or fabricated tracking number. Indicators include 
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: returns_processing
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "refund_request"
        refund_reason|contains:
            - "item_not_received"
            - "return_in_transit"
    filter_tracking_anomaly:
        tracking_delivery_address_match: false
    filter_weight:
        tracking_package_weight_oz|lt: 4
        order_expected_weight_oz|gt: 16
    filter_known_pattern:
        tracking_id_pattern_match: "ftid_known_format"
    condition: selection and (filter_tracking_anomaly or filter_weight or filter_known_pattern)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0062: Fake Tracking ID (FTID) Refund Fraud Indicators (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Abnormally High Refund Rate Per Customer Account
status: experimental
description: Detects customer accounts with an abnormally high refund-to-order ratio over a rolling window. Accounts exceeding a refund rate of 40% across 10 or more orders within 90 days are flagged as potential 
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: order_management
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "order_completed"
            - "refund_issued"
    aggregation:
        condition: "selection\n| groupby(customer_account_id)\n| where count(event_type='refund_issued') / count(event_type='order_completed') > 0.4\n| where count(event_type='order_completed') >= 10\n"
    timeframe: 90d
    condition: selection | aggregation
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0063: Abnormally High Refund Rate Per Customer Account (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Triangulation Fraud Shipping Pattern Detection
status: experimental
description: Detects orders where the shipping address differs from the billing address and matches known drop-ship or reshipping patterns associated with triangulation fraud. In triangulation fraud, a fraudster l
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: order_management
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "order_placed"
        billing_shipping_address_match: false
    filter_drop_address:
        shipping_address_type|contains:
            - "freight_forwarder"
            - "reshipper"
            - "po_box"
            - "commercial_mailbox"
    filter_shared_address:
        shipping_address_distinct_accounts|gt: 3
    filter_velocity:
        shipping_address_orders_7d|gt: 5
    condition: selection and (filter_drop_address or filter_shared_address or filter_velocity)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0064: Triangulation Fraud Shipping Pattern Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: High-Value Item Not Received Claims Exceeding Threshold
status: experimental
description: Detects "item not received" (INR) claims filed on high-value orders that exceed a configurable dollar threshold. High-value INR claims are a primary vector for refund fraud, particularly when the deli
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: order_management
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "dispute_filed"
        dispute_reason: "item_not_received"
    filter_high_value:
        order_total_usd|gte: 500
    filter_delivery_confirmed:
        carrier_delivery_status: "delivered"
    filter_repeat:
        account_inr_claims_90d|gte: 2
    condition: selection and filter_high_value and (filter_delivery_confirmed or filter_repeat)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0066: High-Value Item Not Received Claims Exceeding Threshold (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Excessive Promotional Code or Coupon Abuse from Related Accounts
status: experimental
description: Detects excessive use of promotional codes, referral bonuses, or coupon offers from accounts that share common attributes such as device fingerprint, IP address, payment method, or shipping address. T
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: payment_gateway
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "order_placed"
        promo_code_applied: true
    filter_device_cluster:
        device_fingerprint_promo_uses_30d|gt: 5
    filter_ip_cluster:
        source_ip_promo_uses_30d|gt: 10
    filter_payment_cluster:
        payment_method_hash_promo_uses_30d|gt: 5
    filter_new_account:
        account_age_days|lt: 7
        promo_type|contains:
            - "new_customer"
            - "referral_bonus"
            - "first_order"
    condition: selection and (filter_device_cluster or filter_ip_cluster or filter_payment_cluster or filter_new_account)
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0067: Excessive Promotional Code or Coupon Abuse from Related Accounts (Sigma)
